_about: Folder agents: Claude sessions whose operating script is the folder's CLAUDE.md, started by a zsh function in ~/.zshrc (setup in each folder's README). my-repo lists them; a tooling/ folder with a CLAUDE.md missing here shows as a loose end.

butler.desc: Daily check-in: reads email, calendar, lists, trips and month-end jobs, then says only what needs you.

boss.desc: PR-driven implementation orchestrator: dispatches a crew on boss:ready plans, verifies, merges, deploys on your say.

chief.desc: Repo maintainer: runs one hygiene job at a time, proposes fixes, applies only what you approve.
